The worked example in the decisions log doesn't match what the code will show on screen.

The elapsed-ms text is formatted twice with near-identical logic: once in `log_step()` (`diff.patch` line ~22, `const timed = ... "${detail} (${ms}ms)"`) and again in `set_state()`'s connecting branch (`diff.patch` line ~53, same `"${this.steps.mic} (${...}ms)"` shape). One small helper (e.g. `this.timed_step(stage)`) would read the same stamped value from `this.stage_log` in both places instead of recomputing it from `connect_started_at` a second time — simpler, and the two can't drift apart.

The decisions.md text implies all three checkpoints (mic open, first audio, first Whisper answer) update the big status line, but `log_step()`'s guard is `this.state === "connecting" && stage === "mic"` — the "first answer" checkpoint (`Dictate.js` diff, stage `"whisper"`) can only ever reach the small diagnostic tray / `this.stage_log`, never the big status word, because by the time Whisper answers the state has already moved to `"listening"`. Not a bug in practice (nothing wrong is ever shown), just worth tightening the doc's wording so a future reader doesn't go looking for "first answer" in the big status line.
